code:
import networkx as nx, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from collections import Counter

name = {
 177:"Mito. dysfunction",1115:"ROS increase",1262:"Apoptosis",1339:"Intracell. Ca2+ increase",
 2146:"MEK/ERK activation",352:"Neurodegeneration",188:"Neuroinflammation",55:"Cell injury/death",
 201:"NMDAR antagonist binding",195:"NMDAR inhibition",52:"Decreased Ca2+ influx",381:"Reduced BDNF",
 2287:"Impaired Na-Ca exchange",389:"Intracell. Ca2+ overload",2289:"RyR2 hyperphosphoryl.",
 2292:"Altered cardiac conduction",1106:"Cardiac arrhythmia (AO)",1562:"Decr. Na/K-ATPase",
 1321:"Intracell. Na+ increase",1532:"Decr. cardiac contractility",1535:"Heart failure (AO)",
 2281:"Uncoordinated contraction",2283:"Early premature depol.",593:"ERG K+ channel inhibition",
 1961:"Prolonged AP duration",1962:"QT prolongation",698:"Altered action potential",
 1963:"Torsades de Pointes",2151:"Disrupted NT release",693:"cAMP increase",
 2290:"Funny current inhibition",2291:"Slowed heart rate",341:"Learning/memory impair (AO)",
 2288:"PDE inhibition",1529:"L-type Ca2+ channel block"}

aop_edges = {
 500:[(177,1115),(1115,1262),(1339,1262),(2146,1339),(1339,177),(1262,352),(352,341)],
 499:[(2146,1339),(1339,2151),(2151,341)],
 12:[(352,188),(55,188),(201,195),(188,352),(195,52),(52,381),(381,55),(352,341)],
 556:[(2287,389),(1562,1321),(389,1532),(1532,1535),(1321,2287)],
 558:[(2289,389),(389,1532),(1532,1535),(693,2289),(2288,693)],
 552:[(2281,1535),(1963,2281),(698,1962),(1962,1963),(1529,698)],
 555:[(2283,1535),(593,1961),(1961,1962),(1962,2283)],
 560:[(2292,1106),(2290,2291),(2291,2292)]}
cluster={12:'neuro',499:'neuro',500:'neuro',552:'cardiac',555:'cardiac',556:'cardiac',558:'cardiac',560:'chrono'}
ccol={'neuro':'#4C72B0','cardiac':'#C44E52','chrono':'#55A868'}

node_cluster={}
for aop,edges in aop_edges.items():
    for u,v in edges:
        for n in (u,v): node_cluster.setdefault(n,Counter())[cluster[aop]]+=1
node_cluster={n:c.most_common(1)[0][0] for n,c in node_cluster.items()}

G0=nx.DiGraph()
for aop,edges in aop_edges.items():
    for u,v in edges: G0.add_edge(u,v)

merge={1339:389}
rl=lambda u: merge.get(u,u)
Gc=nx.DiGraph()
for aop,edges in aop_edges.items():
    for u,v in edges: Gc.add_edge(rl(u),rl(v))
consensus_edges=[(2283,1106),(1963,1106)]
for u,v in consensus_edges: Gc.add_edge(u,v)
print("ORIG comps",len(list(nx.weakly_connected_components(G0))),"| CONSENSUS comps",len(list(nx.weakly_connected_components(Gc))),"nodes",Gc.number_of_nodes())
name[389]="Ca2+ overload\n(consensus +KE1339)"
node_cluster[389]='cardiac'

AOs={341,1535,1106}
def draw(G,ax,title,extra=None):
    pos=nx.spring_layout(G,k=1.2,iterations=400,seed=5)
    ncols=[ccol[node_cluster.get(n,'cardiac')] for n in G.nodes()]
    ec=['gold' if n in AOs else 'white' for n in G.nodes()]
    lw=[3.5 if n in AOs else 1 for n in G.nodes()]
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G,pos,ax=ax,node_color=ncols,node_size=1400,edgecolors=ec,linewidths=lw)
    reg=[e for e in G.edges() if not(extra and e in extra)]
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G,pos,ax=ax,edgelist=reg,arrows=True,arrowsize=15,edge_color='#999',width=1.3,node_size=1400)
    if extra:
        nx.draw_networkx_edges(G,pos,ax=ax,edgelist=list(extra),arrows=True,arrowsize=20,edge_color='crimson',width=3,style='dashed',node_size=1400)
    nx.draw_networkx_labels(G,pos,{n:name.get(n,str(n)) for n in G.nodes()},ax=ax,font_size=7)
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=15,fontweight='bold'); ax.axis('off')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(26,13))
draw(G0,axes[0],"A. Original 8 Lead AOPs (as authored) — 3 disconnected components")
draw(Gc,axes[1],"B. Consensus-unified network — 1 component",extra=set(consensus_edges))
leg=[mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['neuro'],label='Neurodevelopmental (AOP 12,499,500)'),
     mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['cardiac'],label='Cardiac contractility/EP (AOP 552,555,556,558)'),
     mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['chrono'],label='Chronotropic (AOP 560)'),
     mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white',edgecolor='gold',linewidth=3,label='Adverse Outcome'),
     plt.Line2D([0],[0],color='crimson',lw=3,ls='--',label='Consensus KER added')]
axes[1].legend(handles=leg,loc='lower left',fontsize=10,framealpha=0.9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('lead_aop_consensus_network.png',dpi=130,bbox_inches='tight')
print("saved lead_aop_consensus_network.png")
